pull_request.title: docs(readme): add nightly toolchain prerequisite for building the linter
pull_request.body:
## Summary

The README's "Prerequisites" section omitted the required nightly toolchain channel that is needed to build the linter. Since the lints link against `rustc_private`, they only build on the specific nightly the project pins (`nightly-2026-04-16` in `rust-toolchain`). A consumer on stable gets a cryptic `rustc_private`/link failure with no pointer to the cause.

## Changes

- **Prerequisites:** Added a step to install the pinned nightly toolchain from `rust-toolchain`, with an explanation of why the nightly is required (links against `rustc_private`)
- **Installation:** Updated the `cargo install` command to use `cargo +<channel-from-rust-toolchain>`
- **Quick Start:** Trimmed to reference the Prerequisites section, keeping it concise while directing readers to the full setup instructions

## Design decisions

- Uses `<channel-from-rust-toolchain>` placeholder instead of hardcoding the date — the single source of truth is `rust-toolchain`
- A parenthetical example cites the current CI channel for orientation, but commands use the placeholder pattern

Closes #132
